flags.person: Michigan City Area Schools (district employee, not a candidate)
flags.summary: Hometown News Now reported on Oct. 5, 2026 that a Michigan City Area Schools employee faces one Level 6 felony fraud count, filed in July 2025, over alleged personal use of $3,986.11 in district funds. The State Board of Accounts reported in late August 2026 that MCAS lacked proper internal controls over some financial policies. The district's business manager acknowledged the findings and listed eight corrective actions. The employee resigned May 6, 2025, and a hearing was set for Oct. 26 in La Porte Superior Court 4. The case is unresolved.
flags.note: This concerns a district employee, not a candidate. It may matter for board oversight of finances during the referendum campaign. The charge is unresolved. No candidate statement on the audit findings was found. Editor: relevant as a district-level overview item (top of the district's ballot section), not a candidate item. Further study: identify who oversees the area involved (board members and administrators responsible for finance/internal controls) and how the board responded to the audit.
